name: Fireflies
free_plan_limits: Limited AI summaries and storage (sources differ)
notes: Per seat a month: Pro $10 yearly / $18 monthly; Business $19 yearly / $29 monthly; Enterprise $39 yearly only. Free-plan numbers differ between Fireflies pages.

name: Loom
since_note: Company founded 2015; first product released June 2016 (Wikipedia).
best_for: Recording short screen videos, not meetings
notes: Loom records your screen; it is not a meeting-notes bot, so it does not join calls. $18 per creator (Business), $24 with AI. Page shows 'save up to 17%'; billing term not clearly stated. Viewers and Creator Lite seats are free.

name: Granola
free_plan_limits: Basic plan, 30 days of note history, few integrations
best_for: Notes from calls without a bot joining
notes: Business $14 and Enterprise $35 per user a month, per Granola's own blog. Business adds unlimited history, integrations and API access. Pricing page itself not loaded.

name: Fathom
best_for: Free notes for Zoom, Meet and Teams
notes: Premium $20 monthly / $16 yearly (one person). Team $19 monthly / $15 yearly with 2-user minimum; Business $34 / $25, 2-user minimum. Priced here as Team x 2 users.

name: Otter
free_plan_limits: 300 minutes a month, 30 minutes per meeting, 20 AI chat questions
since_note: Company founded 2016 as AISense; Otter app debuted March 2018 (Wikipedia).
best_for: Live transcripts with a free starter plan
notes: Pro is $16.99 monthly or $8.33 yearly (1,200 minutes). Business is about $30 monthly or $19.99-$20 yearly (6,000 minutes). Figures from Otter's own blog; pricing page not loaded.

name: Grain
free_plan_limits: Unlimited meetings, 1 notetaker seat, basic AI notes
notes: Business $39 monthly or $29 yearly per seat, 2-seat minimum, per Grain's billing page. A cheaper Starter tier ($15-$19) shows on older pages; not confirmed current.

name: tl;dv
free_plan_limits: Unlimited recording; 10 AI-processed meetings a month
best_for: Free recording with clips to share
notes: Pro is $18 yearly or $29 monthly per user. Business price differs across tl;dv posts ($29 to $59). Figures from tl;dv's own blog.

name: Read AI
best_for: Meeting scores and reports across many apps
notes: Pro $19.75 monthly or $15 yearly; Enterprise $29.75 monthly or $22.50 yearly. From a Read support article about 16 months old; live page not checked.
